name: cll-envelope
description: Explicit high-cost scout at representative CLL analysis-unit dimensions with a bounded target universe.
limitations: The benchmark generator writes a dense TSV in bounded gene blocks because SPATHI consumes the ANDREA-compatible dense input contract. These cases measure a conservative synthetic envelope, not sparse H5 ingestion.

Only eight targets, ten trees per model, and twenty PCA components are used. Target-count, estimator-count, and production-default extrapolations must be derived from the progressive profile and validated separately.
The observed ET29/CD8 unit has one group and is run with SPATHI's required cell-distance, Euclidean, no-group-correction configuration; multigroup cases use the group-anchored configuration.
Groups are balanced synthetic populations, unlike the strongly imbalanced observed CLL groups.
Run this profile only after the progressive scout succeeds; the largest dense synthetic expression TSV is expected to approach two gigabytes and can require several gigabytes of transient memory.

cases.description: ET29/CD8 dimensions: 319 cells x 14,058 genes x 1,000 TFs x one group.
